entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell!? We ain't doin' shit to it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh? Futaba!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You came into your cognitive world!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mm-hm...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The person themselves coming into their[n]own Palace? If that happens...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's...

entries.speaker: Deep Male Voice
entries.en: You killed her!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No...

entries.speaker: Sharp Male Voice
entries.en: Why don't you say something!?

entries.speaker: Shrill Female Voice
entries.en: It's your fault!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's my fault...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's my fault that Mom...

entries.speaker: Palace Monster
entries.en: That's right!

entries.speaker: Palace Monster
entries.en: You killed me!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Wait, is that monster her mother!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Futaba's desires and guilt must've[n]distorted her cognition of her.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The wish that her mother was alive again[n]is mixed in as well, along with those eerie[n]jeers...

entries.speaker: Cognitive Wakaba
entries.en: You are nothing but a demon who stood[n]in my way! I wish you had never been[n]born!

entries.speaker: Cognitive Wakaba
entries.en: That way I could've announced my results[n]without having to waste my time on you!

entries.speaker: Cognitive Wakaba
entries.en: I poured my heart and soul into that[n]research! It would've been the discovery[n]of the century!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What does she mean by that?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Could she be talking about cognitive[n]psience?

entries.speaker: Cognitive Wakaba
entries.en: You're going to die!

entries.speaker: Cognitive Wakaba
entries.en: There's no meaning to your life! No one[n]needs you!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Nobody cares about me...

entries.speaker: Adult Man
entries.en: "I should never have had Futaba..."[n]"She was always such a bother..."

entries.speaker: Adult Man
entries.en: It seems you caused your mother a great[n]deal of trouble, Futaba-chan...

entries.speaker: Adult Man
entries.en: She must have had some kind of[n]maternity neurosis...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: N-Ngh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, we're gonna be in deep shit if[n]this keeps up!

entries.speaker: Young Woman
entries.en: Aaagh... Agh...!

entries.speaker: Young Woman
entries.en: ...F-Futabaaa...

entries.speaker: Young Woman
entries.en: ...Y-You... aaaaaareee...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ngh...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So because she thinks she killed her[n]mother... and because she thinks she[n]deserves to die...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Futaba gave birth to a Palace where[n]her mother wants her dead?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan, look! There's no way that[n]monster is your mother!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's just an illusion you created!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: B-But...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: She never abused you, did she!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Boss told us! He said she did her best to[n]raise you alone!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Isn't this a false memory that's been[n]imprinted upon you?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A false memory?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Aagh...

entries.speaker: Adult Man
entries.en: You made your mother destroy all her[n]research, Futaba-chan...

entries.speaker: Adult Man
entries.en: She had worked so hard on it as well...

entries.speaker: Adult Man
entries.en: She lost her mind, and it's all because of[n]you...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: M-Mom... I-I...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's her Shadow!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Futaba Sakura! Remember!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: You're the reason she committed suicide.[n]You were just getting in the way of her[n]research.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Why did you think it was suicide?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...Because of the note.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Exactly.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: The men in black suits read her suicide[n]note to you, and what was written on it?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: All of her complaints... about me.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Yes. The shock and the pain led you to[n]avert your eyes.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: But they kept reading it aloud in front of[n]your relatives.

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Think hard. Was that suicide note real?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Would the mother you loved so much[n]truly have written that?

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Did she ever say such horrible things[n]to you?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: She scolded me whenever I had tantrums,[n]but she cared for me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: Then what about the suicide note?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A total lie!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: You were used!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: They forged her suicide note and laid[n]the blame of her death upon you!

entries.speaker: Shadow Futaba
entries.en: They trampled all over your young heart![n]Get mad! Don't forgive those rotten[n]adults!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's because I couldn't face myself,[n]or Mom's death...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Even then, why did they have to yell at me[n]like that!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ah...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Futaba-chan!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ngh!

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: What denies you is an illusion...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: A curse put upon you by the heartless...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: You knew from the very beginning...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: And yet, you cowered in fear...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...That's right. I knew, but I...

entries.speaker: Cognitive Wakaba
entries.en: It's all your fault! This time, you'll be[n]the one to die!

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Will you die as you are told?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Who will you obey?

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Cursed words spat out by a seething[n]illusion? Or the truth within your[n]own soul?

entries.speaker: Cognitive Wakaba
entries.en: It's your fault! It's all your fault!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I won't let those distorted lies deceive me[n]anymore...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And I won't be led astray by other's voices[n]either...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm going to trust my own eyes and my[n]own heart to distinguish the truth from[n]the lies.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's no way you're my mom! You're[n]just a fake created by those horrid adults!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll... I'll never...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll never forgive them!
